kind.description: 'sandbox' (default) is a forked sandbox state. 'assignment' is a file upload from an assignment page; `sandbox` then holds the assignment slug (assignment-01) and `primary` names the file the gallery shows.

primary.description: Assignment submissions only: the asset the gallery renders (an image, a PDF, or one self-contained HTML file).

student.description: Server-assigned from the submitting token. Anything sent here is ignored.

gallery_text.description: Two sentences. Text that might accompany a work of art.

answers.description: Assignment submissions only: answers to the assignment's `questions:` frontmatter, keyed by question key. Shown on the gallery page under the question's label.

params.description: Validated separately against the per-sandbox schema in src/lib/sandboxes/<slug>/schema.json.

cover.description: The state the cover screenshot is taken at. Defaults to params.

app_version.description: So a submission can be migrated when a sandbox changes mid-semester.
